scripts.build:
bun build src/cli/daemon.ts --target=node --outfile release/proton-sync.js --alias.bun:sqlite=./src/sync/sqlite.ts && python3 -c "with open('release/proton-sync.js', 'r+') as f: c = f.read().replace('import { Database as Database2 } from "bun:sqlite";', 'const Database2 = class { constructor(f, o) { return new Database(f, o); } };').replace('import { Database } from "bun:sqlite";', 'const Database_bun = class { constructor(f, o) { return new Database(f, o); } };'); f.seek(0); f.write(c); f.truncate()" && printf '#!/bin/bash
NODE_BIN="$(command -v node || echo /usr/bin/node)"
exec "$NODE_BIN" "$(dirname "$0")/proton-sync.js" "$@"
' > release/proton-sync && chmod +x release/proton-sync
